title: Cleanup script deletes with an unquoted, possibly empty variable

base.scripts/clean.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
BUILD_DIR="${1:?build dir required}"
rm -rf "${BUILD_DIR:?}/"*

labels.defect: rm -rf on an unquoted variable that can now be empty (-u removed, :? removed)
labels.evidence: With no argument BUILD_DIR is empty and the command becomes `rm -rf /*`; word-splitting on paths with spaces deletes unrelated entries.
